metadataRaw.title: Easy Core Strengthening Exercises (for NO MORE BACK PAIN)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates easy, safe core-strengthening exercises designed to help fix and eliminate back pain for good.

These exercises target the muscles that protect and support the spine, helping reduce strain, improve movement, and prevent future back pain. They are ideal for daily use or 2–3 times per week to build lasting core strength.

For best results, go through all of the exercises and focus on the ones that help you the most.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:45 Dead Bug
2:31 Bridge
4:40 Bird Dog
6:14 Side Plank
8:00 Seated Exercise
